summary: Rebuilds a linked list of 92-byte scene entries. First frees any existing list whose head is stored at this+0x20, freeing each node (and calling ShortComputation_8cf0(1) when a node has its flag byte at +8 set and a nonzero first dword), then zeroes the four list pointers/counter fields (offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28, 0x2C). If the scene count dword_8AC488 is not positive, returns 1. Otherwise, for each of dword_8AC488 entries it allocates a 92-byte node, sets the first dword to 0 and the second to -1, initializes two 5-dword sub-structs at node+12 and node+52 via SmallEntryStructInit, initializes the text-format block via TextFormatStructInitializer_4fe0, calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on the source record (global dword_8AC490 with a per-entry stride of 396 plus an offset of 260), stores the entry index at node+8, builds commentary TV/PWS paths via CommentaryTVPWSPathBuilder, then allocates a 12-byte wrapper (fields: node pointer, 0, flag 1) and appends it to the list, updating head this+0x20, tail this+0x24, first-insert this+0x28 and count this+0x2C. Returns 0.

operations.description: Traverse the existing scene list starting from the head stored at this[8] (offset 0x20), following the next-pointer at node+4 until null.
For each visited node read the flag byte at node+8 and the next-pointer at node+4, advancing the traversal.
If a node's flag byte at node+8 is nonzero and its first dword is nonzero, call ShortComputation_8cf0(1).
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(node) to free each node during cleanup.
Zero the list head this[8] (offset 0x20), tail this[9] (offset 0x24), first-insert this[10] (offset 0x28) and count this[11] (offset 0x2C) after cleanup.
If the scene entry count dword_8AC488 is <= 0, return 1 without rebuilding.
Iterate once per scene entry, from index 0 until the index reaches dword_8AC488.
Call OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(92) to allocate a 92-byte scene entry node.
If the allocation succeeded, set node[0] to 0 and node[1] to -1.
Initialize two 5-dword sub-structs starting at node+12 (v6+3) via SmallEntryStructInit, advancing by 5 dwords each.
Initialize two 5-dword sub-structs starting at node+52 via SmallEntryStructInit, advancing by 5 dwords each.
Call TextFormatStructInitializer_4fe0(node) to initialize the text-format block of the node.
Call StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on the source record address computed as (running per-entry offset v15 + dword_8AC490 + 260).
Store the running entry index into node+8.
Call CommentaryTVPWSPathBuilder(node) to build track TV/PWS commentary paths for the entry.
Call OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) to allocate the 12-byte list wrapper node.
If the wrapper allocation succeeded, set wrapper[0] to the scene node, wrapper[1] to 0 and the byte flag wrapper[2] to 1.

Append the wrapper to the list: if head this[8] (offset 0x20) is set, write it into the next-pointer slot at *(this+0x24)+4 of the tail node; otherwise set head this[8] and first-insert this[10] (offset 0x28) to the wrapper.
Update tail this[9] (offset 0x24) to the new wrapper, increment the count this[11] (offset 0x2C), advance the entry index and add 396 to the running per-entry offset v15.
Return 0 on successful rebuild of the scene list.

The 396-byte stride and the +260 string-copy target imply dword_8AC490 points to an array of fixed-size scene records, but the record layout is not confirmed by this packet alone.
